title: Catalog honesty
pass_condition: A registry label alone cannot produce live_verified or licensed=true
evidence_needed: Static registry + actual permissions + run receipt
boundary: Do not change registry in this research

title: No-social-account basic flow
pass_condition: Import/read/basic analysis/edit/save/reopen works without social-login dependency; actor/workspace permission enforced
evidence_needed: Original file/version, saved work readback, reopen recording
boundary: Needs actual app execution authorization; not run

title: Public exact-URL source
pass_condition: Capture source URL/time/version/truncation; successful parse never claims whole-site coverage
evidence_needed: Page capture, resource rights, extraction flags
boundary: Stop on access denial/challenge; no bypass

title: Pagination and duplicates
pass_condition: Record every next token; retain repeated records and idempotent writes; empty/short page not independently final
boundary: Bound by query/time/scope, not arbitrary page count

title: Nested comments
pass_condition: Every eligible root/reply task explicitly finished or blocked; counts not substituted for body
evidence_needed: Tree IDs, parent IDs, child-task ledger
boundary: Stop only with terminal provider condition or explicit budget/permission state

title: Time semantics
pass_condition: UTC/local and seconds/milliseconds correct; content/event/observed timestamps separate
evidence_needed: Boundary fixtures plus authorized live sample
boundary: No claim historical metrics from present cumulative snapshot

title: Identity namespace
pass_condition: No automatic cross-platform real-person merge; candidate and confirmed relation distinct

title: Native metrics
pass_condition: Source field/version/unit/observed_at recorded; no reach=impressions or unknown=0
boundary: Derived fields never overwrite native observations

title: Media use
pass_condition: Separate preview/download/edit/export permissions; expired URL handled without fake missing asset deletion
evidence_needed: Allowed use record + expiry and refresh behavior
boundary: No unauthorized binary download or third-party model transmission

title: Regional evidence
pass_condition: Language, author locale, event location, visibility region and audience market kept separate

title: Rate recovery
target: 429 / quota / budget simulation then approved test
pass_condition: Rate/credit/daily quota/local budget distinguished; checkpoint resumes once allowed
evidence_needed: Headers, error code, run state and retry record
boundary: No account/proxy rotation to evade control

title: Revocation/deletion
target: Withdrawn source right or deleted object
pass_condition: Source changes propagate to caches/index/derivatives/export access as contract requires
evidence_needed: Deletion/refresh receipt and dependent artifact statuses
boundary: Do not erase permitted historical audit indiscriminately; legal policy approval required

title: Export gate
pass_condition: Only fields/audience/use actually allowed are exported; raw-data allowance not inferred from successful collection
evidence_needed: Export manifest + current terms + recipient scope
boundary: No customer export in this research

title: Challenge containment
target: One blocked source while authorized materials exist
pass_condition: Blocked source pauses; other independent allowed work and edit/reopen continue
boundary: Never extract hidden tokens or bypass challenge

title: Competitor paired evaluation
pass_condition: Compare actual source capability separately from same-input analysis quality
evidence_needed: Vendor plan/version, licensed sample, source gaps, cost/time
boundary: Requires test access/contract; do not rank from marketing

title: SourceUse handoff
pass_condition: Same source/version and action-specific rights preserved; analysis does not silently become confirmed business fact
boundary: No new truth database or parallel collector
